scenario: A commercial real estate buyer commissions a Phase I Environmental Site Assessment (ESA) under ASTM E1527. An AI pipeline parses the subject property's site history and regulatory database listings, converts the ASTM-specified search radius to the correct distance unit for the database query, audits each regulatory hit for current status, and generates the final Phase I ESA report stating whether Recognized Environmental Conditions (RECs) exist.
info_flow: unit-convert translates the ASTM search radius from miles to feet for the regulatory database query, establishing the perimeter of the database search → presale-regulation-auditor ingests the site history document and all regulatory hits returned within the computed radius, then audits each entry for staleness or resolved status and produces a rule-status table → reporting reads the rule-status table and the regulatory hit list to compose the Phase I ESA conclusion section, including the REC determination.
